title: Analista de Suporte de Sistemas e Desenvolvimento Sr.
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Analista de Suporte de Sistemas e Desenvolvimento Sr. em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo? Então essa é a sua chance! Buscamos: Analista de Suporte de Sistemas e Desenvolvimento Sênior - CRM & Panel Member App  Visão Geral:   O Ibope está conduzindo uma grande transformação de suas operações de Audiência. Estamos redesenhando nosso modelo operacional global e processos, viabilizados pela implementação de uma nova plataforma global de CRM (Microsoft Dynamics 365 – Customer Service e Field Service) e de um aplicativo voltado aos painelistas (Panel Member App, PMA). Este programa irá transformar profundamente a forma como nos relacionamos, gerenciamos e escalamos nossa comunidade de painelistas, melhorando a integridade dos dados, a eficiência operacional e a experiência geral dos painelistas. O PMA é uma solução desenvolvida internamente, e ambas as plataformas estão sendo entregues em parceria com um integrador de sistemas terceirizado. Como parte dessa transformação, estamos construindo uma capacidade global de suporte L1/L2/L3 para garantir estabilidade, performance e adoção em todos os mercados. Responsabilidades:   Estamos buscando um Desenvolvedor Sênior com perfil hands-on para atuar em um ambiente de suporte em produção, suportando e estabilizando o ecossistema de CRM e do Panel Member App. Essa função é focada na análise e resolução de problemas complexos em um ambiente operacional multinacional, trabalhando em conjunto com times internos e com o integrador de sistemas para implementar correções e melhorias. Fornecer suporte técnico L2/L3 para CRM (Dynamics 365), Panel Member App e integrações; Diagnosticar e resolver problemas complexos em sistemas distribuídos (CRM, mobile, APIs, backend e camadas de dados), utilizando logs, ferramentas de monitoramento e telemetria; Apoiar gestão de incidentes, correção de defeitos e ciclos de release para garantir estabilidade em produção; Realizar análise de causa raiz (root cause analysis) para identificar a origem dos problemas (aplicação, integração, dados, infraestrutura ou segurança); Interagir com stakeholders operacionais, de produto e regionais para priorizar issues e comunicar causas, impactos e ações de resolução; Diagnosticar problemas e coordenar com o integrador e times internos para implementar correções nas plataformas relevantes; Analisar fluxos de dados e garantir consistência entre sistemas integrados; Manter documentação clara e compartilhar conhecimento com o time.  Requisitos:  Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas. Mais de 7 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software ou suporte em produção.  Suporte em Produção & Diagnóstico (Crítico): Experiência sólida em ambientes de suporte L2/L3 (preferencialmente além de experiência apenas em projetos); Excelentes habilidades de diagnóstico e troubleshooting em sistemas distribuídos complexos; Experiência comprovada em ambientes operacionais reativos (ex: call center, operações de campo, plataformas voltadas ao cliente).  Tecnologia & Sistemas: Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento, logging ou observabilidade em ambientes produtivos; Experiência em ambientes corporativos complexos com sistemas modernos e legados; Conhecimento em Microsoft Dynamics 365 e Power Platform (foco em troubleshooting, não desenvolvimento principal); Experiência com arquiteturas de integração (REST APIs, GraphQL, sistemas orientados a eventos); Conhecimento em aplicações mobile (iOS/Android) e sistemas operacionais como telefonia ou field service; Visão ampla de aplicações, dados, infraestrutura e segurança em sistemas distribuídos; Familiaridade com ferramentas DevOps e ambientes múltiplos (Dev, QA, UAT, Prod).  Diferenciais: Experiência com Dynamics 365 em produção; Experiência em plataformas globais e multi-país; Experiência com modelos de entrega envolvendo integradores de sistema (SI).  Idioma:  Inglês fundamental nível avançado.  Por que se juntar a nós?  Atuará de forma central na transformação de um dos principais domínios de produto e da maior operação global da empresa; Trabalhará em mudanças de alto impacto, em escala global; Colaborará com stakeholders seniores, líderes de produto e especialistas técnicos globais; Oportunidade de equilibrar entrega prática (hands-on) com transformação de longo prazo.  O que oferecemos?  Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade: Vale Refeição e Alimentação Horário Flexível Modelo de trabalho remoto Assistência Médica e Odontológica Convênio Farmácia Participação nos Lucros e Resultados Previdência Privada Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos Convênio com empresas parceiras Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais Programa de Mobilidade Interna: valorizamos talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua  Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você! No IBOPE a diversidade faz parte do negócio, gerando inovação e resultados. Não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência, gravidez, estado civil ou qualquer outra forma de discriminação.

title: Engenheiro(a) / Arquiteto(a) de Plataforma IA & MCP
description:
Empresa está contratando Engenheiro(a) / Arquiteto(a) de Plataforma IA & MCP em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Atuar como referência técnica na construção e evolução da plataforma corporativa de Inteligência Artificial baseada em MCP (Model Context Protocol), sendo responsável pela arquitetura, integração e governança de agentes inteligentes, ferramentas e APIs corporativas. Desenvolver soluções escaláveis, seguras e orientadas a eventos que permitam a orquestração de agentes de IA conectados aos ecossistemas de negócio da empresa, promovendo automação cognitiva, interoperabilidade e reutilização de contexto entre sistemas enterprise. Responsabilidades & Atribuições  Desenvolver e evoluir arquiteturas baseadas em MCP (Model Context Protocol) para integração entre agentes de IA, ferramentas e sistemas corporativos. Construir e sustentar MCP Servers, AI Gateways e hubs de ferramentas reutilizáveis para consumo por agentes inteligentes. Desenvolver integrações entre agentes IA e APIs corporativas, ERPs, CRMs, sistemas financeiros, plataformas de dados e sistemas legados. Atuar na construção de arquiteturas multiagentes com foco em orquestração, compartilhamento de contexto, tool calling e reasoning distribuído. Desenvolver soluções de AI Platform voltadas para escalabilidade, governança, observabilidade e segurança de agentes. Construir APIs e microsserviços para exposição segura de dados e ferramentas corporativas para agentes inteligentes. Participar da definição de padrões técnicos para interoperabilidade entre agentes, ferramentas e plataformas de IA. Garantir autenticação, autorização, auditoria e governança de acessos em ambientes MCP enterprise. Trabalhar na abstração de sistemas legados através de camadas inteligentes de APIs e ferramentas reutilizáveis. Implementar mecanismos de observabilidade, tracing e monitoramento para ecossistemas de IA. Desenvolver arquiteturas orientadas a eventos para comunicação entre agentes e serviços distribuídos. Participar da definição de estratégias de segurança para agentes inteligentes, prevenindo abuso de ferramentas, vazamento de contexto e acessos indevidos. Trabalhar com arquiteturas cloud-native e ambientes distribuídos em larga escala. Colaborar com times de arquitetura, segurança, cloud, dados e IA para evolução contínua da plataforma. Conduzir POCs e iniciativas estratégicas envolvendo IA Generativa, agentes autônomos, AI orchestration e integração enterprise. Participar da evolução da estratégia de AI Platform da companhia, promovendo reutilização, padronização, governança e escalabilidade.  Obrigatórias / Essenciais  Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas. Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento backend e arquitetura distribuída. Experiência com Python, Node.js, Go ou Java em ambientes enterprise. Conhecimento prático em MCP (Model Context Protocol), Tool Calling e integração de agentes inteligentes. Experiência com APIs REST, GraphQL, microsserviços e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos. Conhecimento em arquiteturas multiagentes e frameworks de orquestração de IA. Experiência com LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen ou frameworks similares. Experiência com LLMs e integração com plataformas OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Azure OpenAI ou similares. Conhecimento em RAG, embeddings, memória contextual e vector databases. Experiência com cloud computing (AWS, Azure ou GCP). Experiência com Docker, Kubernetes e pipelines CI/CD. Conhecimento em autenticação, autorização e segurança de APIs (OAuth2, JWT, RBAC, IAM). Experiência com observabilidade e monitoramento (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Prometheus, LangSmith ou similares). Conhecimento em arquitetura de integração corporativa e exposição segura de ferramentas para agentes IA. Capacidade de atuar em ambientes enterprise de alta escalabilidade e criticidade. Forte visão sistêmica, capacidade analítica e resolução de problemas complexos. Boa comunicação para interação com áreas técnicas e executivas. Inglês técnico para leitura de documentação e integração com fornecedores globais.

title: Senior Solution Architect
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior Solution Architect em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

About the Role  Our client helps organizations turn complex data into actionable intelligence. As a Senior Solution Architect , you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise-grade analytics deployments for customers with complex technical and business needs. You will partner closely with customers, internal stakeholders, and product teams to ensure successful outcomes across architecture, deployment, scalability, and long-term value realization. Why Join the Solution Architect Team?  Work at the intersection of customer success, cloud architecture, and data platforms. Help customers solve complex infrastructure, deployment, and performance challenges across our client’s environments. Collaborate with Product, R&D, Support, and Customer Success teams to shape best practices and improve the platform. Influence architecture decisions for strategic customers and high-visibility engagements.  In This Role, You Will  Lead custom multi-node Linux installations and upgrades for our client’s deployments, including troubleshooting complex deployment issues. Own and troubleshoot multi-node Windows-to-Linux migration projects, backup and restore processes, and architecture-related escalations. Analyze logs, system performance, and infrastructure telemetry to proactively identify risks and optimize customer environments. Partner with customer Application Developers, DevOps engineers, IT teams, and executive sponsors to drive successful outcomes. Act as the voice of the customer by sharing product feedback, submitting bugs and feature requests, and influencing roadmap priorities. Lead enablement initiatives for internal teams, mentor Solution Architects, and support technical interviews for new hires.  What You’ve Accomplished So Far  5+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles, including previous experience as a Solution Architect. Hands-on expertise with Linux (Ubuntu, Amazon Linux, RHEL/CentOS), Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and cloud platforms such as AWS EKS and GKE. Strong experience troubleshooting distributed systems, networking, security, and monitoring tools such as Grafana and Coralogix. Advanced working knowledge of MongoDB or other NoSQL databases, including query optimization and troubleshooting. Intermediate SQL skills, with the ability to join data across disparate sources and optimize queries. Proficiency in scripting and programming using Bash, Python, JavaScript, and CSS. Experience with load-testing tools such as K6 and modern cloud data warehouse technologies (Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery) is a plus. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical teams and executive stakeholders.  How You’ll Ramp Up  By Day 30 Build a strong understanding of our client’s architecture, deployment models, product capabilities, and customer engagement processes.  By Day 60 Independently lead standard and custom deployment activities. Troubleshoot escalations and support customer architecture reviews.  By Day 90 Own complex technical engagements end-to-end. Mentor junior team members.

title: Data Management Analyst
description:
Empresa está contratando Data Management Analyst em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

About InComm  InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share. Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers. Job Summary  We are looking for a Data Management Coordinator  to join our team. This role is fully remote in Brazil (CLT) and supports day-to-day operations related to account setup and billing processes for our US business. In this role, you will be responsible for creating and maintaining account records, ensuring billing information is accurate, and supporting system configurations used in pricing and invoicing. This is a great opportunity for someone detail-oriented who enjoys working with structured processes and has an interest in systems and operational data. Responsibilities   Set up and maintain account records in internal systems; Ensure all billing information is complete and accurate; Process incoming requests through internal tools (e.g., ticketing system); Update account details, contacts, and billing structures as needed; Support system updates related to pricing and billing configurations; Investigate and resolve issues related to billing or data inconsistencies; Work closely with internal teams to ensure smooth operational processes; Meet defined timelines and maintain high data accuracy standards.  Requirements   Experience in administrative, finance, accounting, or data-related roles; Strong Excel skills (e.g., Pivot Tables, data comparison); Professional English communication skills; High attention to detail and organization; Ability to follow structured processes and handle repetitive tasks.  Nice to have   Experience with billing, invoicing, or financial data; Familiarity with ticketing tools or internal systems.  Knowledge, Skills & Abilities   Strong attention to detail; Organized and process-driven mindset; Comfortable working with large volumes of data; Problem-solving skills, especially when dealing with discrepancies; Ability to collaborate across teams.  Benefits    Monthly internet/mobile allowance  ️ Meal and food vouchers   Annual bonus   Health and dental plan

title: Business Information Security Officer
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Business Information Security Officer em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud. The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves. Job Title: Business Information Security Officer (BISO / BSO) Role Summary The Business Information Security Officer (BISO/BSO) serves as the primary security liaison between the business, enterprise security, and GRC functions. The role ensures that information security risks are appropriately identified, assessed by accountable teams (e.g., GRC, vendor risk, compliance), clearly communicated to business stakeholders, and effectively acted upon. The BISO enables secure-by-design execution across business initiatives while ensuring alignment with enterprise security frameworks and regulatory requirements such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, and FedRAMP. Key Responsibilities 1. Secure-by-Design Advisory & Consulting Act as a trusted security advisor to business and delivery teams, embedding security-by-design principles into initiatives from early design stages. Translate enterprise security standards and regulatory requirements (ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, FedRAMP) into actionable guidance and security user stories. Collaborate with architecture, engineering, and security teams to ensure security requirements are understood and incorporated into solution design. 2. SDLC Security Enablement (Coordination Role) Ensure security requirements are integrated into SDLC processes for in-scope applications. Coordinate with GRC, application security, and engineering teams to ensure security assessments, control validation, and remediation activities are executed. Track security findings and ensure remediation plans are clearly understood and actioned by delivery teams. 3. Third-Party Risk & Due Diligence Coordination Act as the business-facing liaison for third-party risk management activities conducted by GRC and vendor risk teams. Ensure due diligence requests are completed by relevant stakeholders and that outcomes are communicated in business terms. Facilitate business understanding of vendor risk posture and support informed risk decisions. 4. Divestiture / Transformation Support (Orthopedic Programs) Support security activities for orthopedic divestiture and transformation initiatives. Coordinate across IT, GRC, security, and business teams to ensure security requirements are addressed during transition planning and execution. Ensure alignment with enterprise security frameworks and regulatory obligations throughout the transformation lifecycle. 5. Physical Site Security Coordination Support physical security assessments for scoped orthopedic sites conducted by appropriate security teams. Ensure findings, gaps, and remediation actions are clearly communicated to business and site leadership. Track remediation progress and support closure of identified risks. 6. Risk Governance, Communication & Collaboration Facilitate security risk acknowledgement and decision-making discussions between GRC and business stakeholders. Ensure risks, control gaps, and mitigation plans are clearly understood and appropriately documented. Enable risk acceptance processes by ensuring business stakeholders are informed and aligned. Collaborate across multiple teams (GRC, IT, engineering, legal, compliance, and business units) to ensure coordinated security outcomes. Key Deliverables Security-by-design guidance aligned to ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, and FedRAMP frameworks Coordinated tracking of SDLC security activities and remediation status Third-party risk communication summaries (from GRC outputs) Divestiture security coordination artifacts and transition support documentation Physical site assessment coordination reports and action tracking Risk acknowledgement and acceptance documentation Executive-level security status reporting for business stakeholders Core Competencies Strong understanding of enterprise security frameworks: ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, FedRAMP Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills Ability to translate technical risk into business impact and decision-ready language Strong coordination Equality & Opportunity for All  Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws   At HCLTech, we don’t just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Join a global team where your work drives innovation, your ideas matter, and your growth is supported every step of the way.   Why Choose HCLTech?  Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint Collaborate with diverse teams across borders Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion

title: Especialista em Governança de Dados
description:
Empresa está contratando Especialista em Governança de Dados em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Somos o Grupo Casas Bahia, com mais de 70 anos de história, realizando os sonhos de +100 milhões de brasileiros. Aqui, somos protagonistas o tempo todo, sempre com integridade e ética em tudo o que fazemos. A paixão pela nossa gente é o que nos move, e a dedicação total ao cliente é o nosso compromisso diário. Entregamos resultados e buscamos sempre a simplicidade em tudo o que fazemos! Buscamos um(a) Especialista em Governança de Dados para estruturar, evoluir e operacionalizar o framework de governança da nossa Plataforma de Dados. Este papel é fundamental para garantir que os dados da companhia sejam confiáveis, descobríveis, seguros e em conformidade — transformando governança de um requisito de compliance em um habilitador de valor para o negócio. Mais do que definir políticas e padrões, este papel exige profundidade técnica em plataformas modernas de dados, visão sistêmica do ciclo de vida do dado e capacidade de implementar governança de forma prática e escalável, embarcada na esteira de desenvolvimento. O objetivo é elevar a maturidade de governança da companhia, tornando-a um diferencial competitivo sustentado por automação e cultura. Responsabilidades  Atuar diretamente na definição, evolução e operacionalização do framework corporativo de Governança de Dados da plataforma. Definir, manter e disseminar políticas, padrões e processos relacionados à governança de dados, incluindo: Catalogação, Classificação, Qualidade de dados, Linhagem, Ciclo de vida do dado; Gestão de acessos. Estruturar e evoluir o catálogo corporativo de dados, garantindo descoberta, documentação, rastreabilidade e contexto de negócio para os ativos de dados. Implementar e governar controles de qualidade de dados, incluindo: Definição de regras; Monitoramento contínuo; Alertas e Processos de remediação. Liderar iniciativas de classificação e proteção de dados sensíveis e pessoais, assegurando conformidade com LGPD e demais regulamentações aplicáveis. Atuar com visão ponta a ponta do ecossistema de dados, compreendendo: Fluxos de dados em arquiteturas modernas (Bronze → Silver → Gold); Linhagem e gestão ativa de metadados; Controles de acesso e segregação de dados; Técnicas de mascaramento, anonimização e proteção de dados. Definir e operacionalizar papéis e responsabilidades de governança: Data Owners; Data Stewards e Custodiantes. Integrar práticas de governança à esteira de desenvolvimento de dados, automatizando controles e reduzindo fricção para os times de engenharia. Atuar em parceria com Segurança da Informação, Privacidade, Jurídico e Compliance em temas relacionados a auditoria, conformidade e resposta a incidentes. Apoiar demandas regulatórias, auditorias e requisições relacionadas a titulares de dados. Definir, acompanhar e comunicar métricas e indicadores de: Maturidade de governança; Qualidade de dados. Promover cultura orientada a dados e disseminar boas práticas de governança na organização, atuando como referência técnica no tema.  Requisitos e Qualificações  Experiência consolidada em Governança de Dados, preferencialmente em: Ambientes de alta complexidade técnica; Contextos com múltiplos stakeholders; Plataformas analíticas, Data Lake, Data Warehouse ou arquiteturas Lakehouse. Conhecimento sólido e aplicado em: Catalogação, classificação e gestão de metadados; Qualidade, linhagem e ciclo de vida de dados; Gestão de acessos e proteção de dados sensíveis; LGPD e frameworks de governança e privacidade, como DAMA-DMBOK, ISO 27001 e SOC 2. Experiência atuando em conjunto com: Engenharia de Dados; Analytics; Segurança da Informação; Privacidade. Capacidade de implementar governança de forma prática; automatizada; integrada aos processos. Forte habilidade para: traduzir requisitos regulatórios em controles técnicos aplicáveis; definir métricas e acompanhar evolução de maturidade; navegar com fluidez entre contextos técnicos, jurídicos e de negócio. Excelente comunicação e capacidade de simplificar temas complexos para diferentes públicos (Técnicos; Executivos; Áreas de negócio). Perfil com: Alta autonomia; Visão sistêmica; Capacidade de influência; Forte orientação a impacto e resultados. Capacidade de engajar áreas multifuncionais sem relação hierárquica direta. Perfil colaborativo, pragmático e orientado à construção de soluções escaláveis.  Seria muito legal se você tivesse (diferencial):  Experiência com: Databricks Unity Catalog, Arquiteturas Lakehouse; Ferramentas de catalogação, qualidade, observabilidade e linhagem de dados. Conhecimento prático em: SQL; Automação de controles; Políticas como código; Data contracts. Experiência com: Integração de logs de auditoria; Soluções de SIEM; Monitoramento de segurança. Certificações em: Governança de Dados; Privacidade; Segurança da Informação. Experiência em: Varejo; E-commerce; Ambientes de alta escala e volumetria de dados. Conhecimento sobre: ANPD; Cenário regulatório brasileiro de proteção de dados. Formação em: Tecnologia; Engenharia; Estatística; Direito Digital; Áreas correlatas.  Confira alguns dos benefícios incríveis que preparamos para garantir seu bem-estar e qualidade de vida:  PLR/Bônus : Um reconhecimento extra para valorizar o seu esforço e dedicação!   Assistência Médica e Odontológica : Para que você tenha toda a segurança e cuidado com a sua saúde e a da sua família.   Vale Refeição : Porque sabemos que uma alimentação de qualidade é essencial para o seu dia a dia!  ️ Seguro de Vida : Tranquilidade e proteção para você e seus entes queridos.

Overview  Full Spectrum Search Group is a national healthcare recruiting firm focused on post-acute and senior care leadership, including skilled nursing, senior living, home health, and hospice. We are hiring a Recruiter to execute on active searches and drive candidate engagement across our client portfolio. This role is responsible for identifying, engaging, and advancing top talent through the interview process. This is a phone-first, outbound recruiting role. Success in this position is driven by the ability to engage passive candidates  and turn initial outreach into meaningful conversations. If you are competitive, relationship-driven, and motivated by results, this role is for you. About the Role  This role sits at the core of our recruiting execution. You will partner with leadership and work closely with the operations and research team to identify and engage candidates for active searches. This is a production-driven role. Your success is measured by activity, candidate quality, and your ability to move candidates through the hiring process. There is a steep but rewarding learning curve. You will be expected to quickly learn both our recruiting process and the nuances of the post-acute healthcare industry, including terminology, roles, and market dynamics. Professional development is a core part of this role. The individuals who succeed here are those who actively invest in learning, improving, and refining their craft. Candidate Sourcing and Outreach  Proactively identify and engage passive candidates  through outbound calling, LinkedIn, CRM databases, referrals, and targeted call sheets Prioritize phone-based outreach  as the primary method of engagement, including calling candidates at their place of work when appropriate Utilize call lists and target data provided by the research team to execute structured outreach campaigns Supplement outreach with LinkedIn messaging, email, and text to increase response rates Manage and respond to inbound candidates (Indeed, LinkedIn, referrals), while maintaining a primary focus on outbound recruiting  Candidate Qualification and Assessment  Conduct high-quality screening calls with both outbound (passive) and inbound candidates Ask targeted, thoughtful questions to uncover experience, motivations, and openness to new opportunities Present opportunities in a clear, compelling way that resonates with passive candidates Accurately document candidate details including compensation expectations, timing, and potential barriers  Pipeline Management and Execution  Build and maintain a pipeline primarily driven by passive candidate outreach , not just inbound applicants Manage multiple active searches simultaneously while maintaining organization and momentum Ensure candidates are consistently moving through the process without delays Prepare candidates for client interviews, including expectations, positioning, and feedback Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in Crelate and related systems  Client and Team Collaboration  Partner with leadership to align on candidate profiles and search priorities Communicate candidate updates, challenges, and market feedback in a timely manner Work closely with the operations and research team to ensure strong execution across all searches Contribute to team discussions around search strategy, candidate quality, and market trends  Performance Expectations  Maintain consistent daily call volume  with a strong emphasis on outbound phone activity Demonstrate the ability to engage and convert passive candidates into active conversations  Build a steady pipeline of qualified candidates sourced through outbound efforts Deliver a consistent number of qualified candidate presentations per week Maintain strong follow-up and response times with candidates and internal team members  What You’ll Bring  Strong verbal and written communication skills suitable for professional U.S. business communication Understanding of American business culture, communication style, and professional expectations Comfort with high-volume outreach and phone-based recruiting Ability to build rapport quickly and maintain relationships with candidates Strong organization and time management skills Competitive, driven mindset with a desire to be successful Positive attitude and ability to keep pace with a fast-moving, high-performing team Strong technical proficiency and comfort learning new tools and systems Professional home office setup suitable for business calls Reliable high-speed internet and availability during U.S. business hours (Central Time)  What Separates Top Recruiters  You are comfortable calling candidates who are not actively looking and earning their interest You default to picking up the phone instead of relying solely on messages or applications You know how to turn a cold call into a meaningful career conversation You actively invest time in learning the industry, terminology, and roles you recruit for You generate your own pipeline rather than relying on inbound flow You maintain persistence and follow-through without being transactional  Ideal Background  Experience in recruiting, sales, or other high-activity, performance-driven roles Experience with outbound calling, business development, or candidate sourcing Familiarity with healthcare or executive recruiting is a plus, but not required Track record of meeting or exceeding performance expectations  Compensation and Logistics  Competitive monthly salary plus performance-based commission Full-time remote position Central Time schedule Performance-based growth opportunities

Technical Business Analyst – FIX Protocol / Trading Applications  We are looking for a Technical Business Analyst  with strong experience in FIX Protocol  and trading applications  to support technology initiatives within a global financial services environment. This role requires a professional who can work closely with business stakeholders, product teams, application development teams and vendors to gather, analyze, document and validate business and technical requirements for trading-related systems. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with SQL queries, UNIX log analysis, functional specifications, data flows, system integrations and UAT support . Key responsibilities Gather, analyze and document business, functional and technical requirements for trading applications. Work closely with business stakeholders, developers, vendors and product teams to define and validate technology solutions. Create and maintain functional specifications, business rules, exception rules and process documentation. Analyze system data across multiple platforms, including UNIX, FIX, Oracle, SQL Server and mainframe environments . Perform SQL queries and UNIX log analysis to support requirements definition, issue investigation and validation. Translate business needs into clear technical requirements for development teams. Support data sourcing activities, validating data completeness from acquisition through report or system delivery. Define and support testing requirements, test cases and UAT activities. Conduct functional walkthroughs and obtain business sign-off. Track project risks, defects, change requests and delivery status. Support multiple projects or workstreams in parallel within the software development lifecycle.  Required experience 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst  or Technical Business Analyst . Strong experience with FIX Protocol . Experience working with trading applications  or capital markets platforms. Hands-on experience with SQL queries . Experience with UNIX log analysis . Ability to write clear functional and technical requirements. Experience creating FSDs , business requirements, test cases and UAT documentation. Good understanding of system integrations, data flows and application troubleshooting. Ability to translate technical concepts to business stakeholders and business requirements to technical teams. Experience working with developers, vendors, product managers and business SMEs. Advanced English for communication with global teams.  Nice to have Experience in financial services, brokerage, investment banking, wealth management or capital markets. Knowledge of Oracle, SQL Server or mainframe environments. title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Technical Support Engineer em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Theta Data  Theta Data is a pioneering data company specializing in low-latency APIs for delivering high-speed options and stocks data. Our mission is to empower users with real-time, actionable information to make well-informed decisions in dynamic financial markets. With a focus on speed and broad data coverage, Theta Data stands at the forefront of the options data industry by providing essential tools and insights. We are dedicated to equipping professionals with the resources needed to excel in a competitive landscape. We’re a small, nimble team growing quickly. Our platform handles billions of database requests daily, and we’re just getting started. The complexity of our data problems is real: tick-level options data is among the most intricate financial data to store, index, and serve at scale. We take engineering seriously. The Role  We're hiring a Technical Support Engineer to be the front line of the customer experience at Theta Data. This is not a generic helpdesk role. Our customers are quantitative researchers, developers, and traders who ask technically sophisticated questions about financial data, APIs, and data integrity. You'll need to understand what they're asking and diagnose problems in depth. Your primary responsibility is to monitor Intercom and Discord to identify, triage, and respond to customer issues as they come in. When you can resolve an issue or provide a working workaround, you do it. When you can't, write a clear, well-documented Jira ticket and escalate to Engineering with everything they need to act quickly, and track the ticket's progress until it's complete. We believe the most important feature is the one the customer already paid for. We take this promise seriously, and we want someone who will, too! What You'll Do  Monitor Intercom and Discord and respond to incoming customer issues in a timely manner Diagnose technical problems related to API behavior, data quality, authentication, request handling, and account set-up Write and run Python scripts to reproduce issues and validate data against expected behavior Make REST API calls to investigate and isolate bugs or unexpected responses Provide workarounds and clear guidance to customers where possible Write thorough, reproducible Jira tickets and escalate unresolved issues Identify recurring issues and surface patterns to help prioritize fixes Create and maintain internal documentation on common issues, workarounds, and resolution steps  What We're Looking For  Required  Experience working in a technical support or customer-facing engineering role Comfort working with REST APIs, including reading documentation, making requests, and interpreting responses Working knowledge of Python for scripting, data inspection, and reproducing issues Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both customers and engineers Detail-oriented and systematic approach to diagnosing problems Weekend support rotation  Nice to Have  Prior experience with financial data APIs Familiarity with financial data concepts (options, equities, market data, OHLCV, Greeks, etc.) Familiarity with Jira or similar issue tracking tools Experience with Intercom or similar support platforms Exposure to SQL or database queries for data validation  Why Theta Data  Rapid growth: the platform and team are both scaling fast Real challenges: data at scale, low-latency systems, complex financial data High ownership: a small team means your decisions matter; you will influence how we operate Remote-first: work from anywhere Direct impact: your work reaches thousands of quants and researchers daily A role that rewards genuine curiosity about financial data and technical problem-solving

Experience in Compliance, AML/Financial Crime, Regulatory Affairs, or a related function within financial services, fintech, payments, banking, or digital assets. Prior experience as an MLRO, Compliance Officer, or similar compliance role is preferred. Good understanding of Brazilian regulatory requirements and AML/CFT obligations. Experience interacting with regulators, auditors, or other external stakeholders is advantageous. Exposure to licensing, regulatory approvals, or compliance projects is beneficial. Experience within digital assets, fintech, payments, or financial institutions is preferred. Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently in a dynamic and evolving environment. Professional certifications such as CAMS, ICA, CFE, or equivalent are a plus. Fluency in English and Portuguese.  Vision & Mission  OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

description:
Empresa está contratando QC Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

About Us  Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens. At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact. Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide. Role Overview  As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives. Key Responsibilities  1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files)  Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.  2. Script-to-Audio Alignment  Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.  3. Technical & Creative Accuracy  Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble  4. Vendor & Artist Coordination  Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.  Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.  5. QC Documentation & Tracking  Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.  6. Pre-Release Quality Checks  Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.  7. Cross-Team Collaboration  Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.  8. Process Improvement  Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology  9. Volume & Deadline Management  Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content  within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.  10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement  Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to: Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery  Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible. Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements. Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement. Qualifications  Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.  Language requirements  Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English  This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis. Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

Zaigo builds AI software for real businesses.Not demos. Not slide decks. Actual tools that people use to run parts of their company.Our clients are usually owner-led or mid-market companies in the US: professional services firms, distributors, manufacturers, healthcare operators, finance teams. They have messy workflows, old systems, weird data, and very little patience for theory. We figure out what should exist, then we build it.We are looking for a senior full-stack engineer who already builds heavily with AI. Someone who can take a vague client problem, turn it into a product plan, build the thing, polish it, ship it, and keep moving.If you need perfect specs, this probably is not the job. If you like owning the whole problem and moving faster than normal teams think is reasonable, it might be.What the work looks likeYou will own client projects end to end.That means you may be on a call with a business owner in the morning, designing the workflow after lunch, and shipping the first usable version that week. The work is full-stack product engineering: database, backend, UI, auth, integrations, AI agents, evals, error handling, deployment, and the judgment to know what should not be handled by a model.Recent Zaigo-style projects include:a document review tool that checks presentations against a firm's brand and compliance rulesa benchmarking platform built from years of public company filingspayroll and operations tools that clean messy data and produce files people can actually useinternal AI agents that help teams move faster without giving the model dangerous autonomyYou do not need to be an ML researcher. You do need to be a very strong engineer who knows how to use AI tools to ship better and faster.Who we are looking forYou are probably a fit if this sounds like you:You have 5+ years building software professionally.You can ship across the stack: frontend, backend, database, integrations, deployment.You use AI coding tools every day, not as a novelty. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, agents, worktrees, parallel terminals, your own setup. We care less about the exact tools and more about whether you have real opinions from using them.You think like a product owner. Clients rarely hand you perfect requirements.You have taste. There is no reason to ship ugly software anymore.You communicate clearly in English and can talk through tradeoffs with US clients.You have high initiative. You fix things nobody assigned. You build outside work because you like building.Bonus points if you have founded something, freelanced, run a small agency, built your own product, or worked directly with clients.Who should not applyThis is probably not the right role if you want a narrow lane, a long roadmap, and fully written tickets.It is also probably not right if your AI experience is mostly prompting ChatGPT, building toy demos, or talking about agents without shipping production software.We need builders. Smart, fast, practical builders.ProcessShort application.10-minute async voice interview.Live interview with Zaigo's founder.Short practical build project.Offer if it is a fit.We move quickly. If there is a fit, you will hear from us within days, not weeks.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Lead Product Designer em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who are we?  Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life. Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing. About the role  This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs. You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here. Key responsibilities  Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.  Must haves  6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.  Nice to have  Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; JavaScript a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

Deep understanding of TypeScript, typing patterns, interfaces, generics, and strict type safety. Experience building REST APIs and/or Route Handlers / Server Actions in Next.js. Experience building React based frontend component with Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules, or other styling systems. Thorough understanding of PostgreSQL (schema design, indexing, query optimization). Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts to a non-technical audience. Self-motivated and able to work effectively both independently and as part of a distributed team. Strong sense of ownership and urgency, with a commitment to delivering high-quality, polished products. Proven ability to quickly adapt to new technologies and a commitment to continuous learning. Creative and analytical mindset for tackling complex technical challenges and driving innovative solutions.  Key Responsibilities  Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable, and secure web applications from end-to-end. Implement user interface and user experience (UI/UX) designs using front-end technologies. Develop and manage back-end services and APIs (Application Programming Interfaces). Integrate front-end components with back-end logic. Write clean, well-documented, and efficient code. Perform testing and debugging to ensure high performance and responsiveness of the application. Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver new features. Maintain code integrity and organization, and participate in code reviews. Stay up-to-date with new technologies and industry best practices.  Why Join Us?  You love building real, meaningful features—not just completing tickets You want autonomy and real ownership. You enjoy solving problems across frontend, backend, and database. You thrive in a fast-paced, iterative environment. You care about clean code and great user experience. We offer Unlimited Vacations Policy. You want a Real 100% remote work (we don't have physical offices to go to \"once per week\"). You want Flex-time and Manage your schedule Policy (we are looking for teamwork and results). You want an opportunity to work closely with leadership and gain cross-functional experience in a fast-growing company at the forefront of the AI revolution.  If you're passionate about AI and innovation and want to be at the forefront of the conversational AI revolution and join a team in the first few years of a great journey, apply today! We might have a seat for you on our rocketship!

À medida que crescemos, precisamos contratar profissionais que não sejam apenas experientes, mas também responsáveis, proativos, estáveis e capazes de resolver problemas de forma independente. Estamos procurando um(a) Líder Sênior de Aquisição de Talentos e Headhunting  para nos ajudar a desenvolver um sistema de contratação mais eficiente e atrair profissionais de alta qualidade para a empresa. Sobre a FunçãoEsta não é uma função tradicional de administração de Recursos Humanos. Procuramos alguém com sólida experiência em headhunting, busca ativa e avaliação de talentos. Essa pessoa deverá abordar ativamente profissionais qualificados, inclusive aqueles que não estejam procurando uma nova oportunidade no momento. O candidato ideal possui mais de cinco anos de experiência em recrutamento, headhunting, busca executiva ou aquisição de talentos. Também deve ter trabalhado em uma empresa de grande porte, consolidada ou com processos bem estruturados, além de apresentar uma trajetória profissional estável, com períodos relevantes de permanência em cargos anteriores. Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com a equipe de liderança para definir as necessidades de contratação, identificar bons candidatos, realizar abordagens, fazer triagens, estruturar processos seletivos e ajudar a empresa a contratar profissionais com verdadeiro senso de responsabilidade, autonomia, capacidade de resolver problemas e alto nível de execução. Principais ResponsabilidadesCriar e gerenciar pipelines de recrutamento para posições estratégicas nas áreas de vendas, implantação, pedagogia, sucesso do cliente, operações e liderança. Buscar candidatos de forma proativa por meio do LinkedIn, indicações, redes profissionais, redes da área de educação, plataformas de recrutamento e abordagens diretas. Identificar candidatos passivos de alta qualidade que talvez não estejam procurando novas oportunidades ativamente. Abordar potenciais candidatos de maneira profissional e persuasiva. Elaborar descrições de vagas claras e atrativas, baseadas nas necessidades reais do negócio. Avaliar candidatos considerando experiência, capacidade de comunicação, responsabilidade, senso de dono, habilidade para resolver problemas e compatibilidade de longo prazo com a empresa. Avaliar os candidatos para além do currículo e do desempenho nas entrevistas. Estruturar processos de entrevista e matrizes de avaliação para diferentes funções. Criar estudos de caso e atividades práticas para verificar se os candidatos realmente sabem pensar, resolver problemas e executar. Coordenar entrevistas com a liderança e os gestores responsáveis pelas contratações. Realizar verificações de referências profissionais e apoiar as decisões finais de contratação. Reduzir a dependência de headhunters externos de alto custo por meio da construção de um sistema interno de aquisição de talentos. Apoiar o processo de integração e a avaliação inicial de desempenho durante os primeiros 30 a 60 dias. Ajudar a liderança a identificar rapidamente quando um candidato ou novo contratado pode não ser adequado para a função ou para a empresa. Desenvolver um processo de contratação replicável, disciplinado e profissional.  Requisitos ObrigatóriosMais de cinco anos de experiência em recrutamento, headhunting, busca executiva ou aquisição de talentos. Experiência comprovada em busca ativa e abordagem direta de candidatos, e não apenas no gerenciamento de candidaturas recebidas. Experiência anterior em uma empresa de grande porte, consolidada ou com processos bem estruturados. Trajetória profissional estável, com permanência relevante em cargos anteriores, geralmente superior a um ano em cada empresa ou função. Forte capacidade de busca de candidatos por meio do LinkedIn, indicações, redes profissionais e abordagens diretas. Capacidade de avaliar candidatos para além do currículo. Bom julgamento para identificar profissionais com senso de dono, responsabilidade, maturidade e capacidade de resolver problemas. Experiência conduzindo processos seletivos para várias posições simultaneamente. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, acompanhamento e coordenação. Alto nível de organização e disciplina, com forte compromisso com prazos. Facilidade para trabalhar em um ambiente de startup dinâmico e em rápido crescimento. Fluência em português. Inglês será um grande diferencial.  Qualificações DesejáveisExperiência como headhunter ou em agência de recrutamento. Experiência recrutando para empresas de EdTech, SaaS, inteligência artificial, educação, tecnologia ou startups. Experiência em contratações para as áreas de vendas, implantação, sucesso do cliente, operações, pedagogia ou liderança. Experiência recrutando profissionais seniores ou candidatos difíceis de encontrar. Familiaridade com o mercado de talentos brasileiro. Experiência na criação de matrizes de avaliação, estruturas de entrevistas e sistemas de avaliação de candidatos. Experiência trabalhando diretamente com fundadores, executivos ou equipes de alta liderança.  O Que ProcuramosProcuramos alguém que não seja apenas um recrutador, mas um verdadeiro caçador de talentos e parceiro estratégico de contratação . Você deverá ser capaz de compreender qual tipo de profissional a empresa realmente precisa, transformar necessidades de contratação pouco definidas em um perfil claro de candidato, encontrar profissionais qualificados de forma proativa e nos ajudar a evitar a contratação de pessoas que gerem mais necessidade de gestão do que valor para a empresa. A pessoa ideal é profissional, estável, madura, organizada e proativa. Deve trazer a disciplina e a estrutura de uma empresa maior, ao mesmo tempo que se sente confortável trabalhando em uma startup dinâmica, na qual as prioridades podem mudar rapidamente. Para Quem Esta Vaga Não É IndicadaEsta vaga não é indicada para alguém que queira atuar apenas com atividades administrativas de Recursos Humanos. Esta vaga não é indicada para alguém que apenas publique oportunidades e espere que os candidatos se inscrevam. Esta vaga não é indicada para alguém que evite realizar abordagens proativas. Esta vaga não é indicada para alguém que precise de orientação constante. Esta vaga não é indicada para alguém com um histórico frequente de mudanças de emprego em períodos curtos, sem justificativas claras. Esta vaga não é indicada para alguém que não consiga trazer estrutura, disciplina e julgamento profissional ao processo de contratação.

description:

Descrição da empresa Na Bosch, moldamos o futuro por meio das inovações tecnológicas de alta qualidade e de serviços que despertam entusiasmo e melhoram a vida das pessoas. Temos uma promessa sólida para nossos colaboradores: crescemos juntos, gostamos do nosso trabalho e inspiramos uns aos outros. Junte-se a nós e sinta a diferença. Descrição do emprego This role is responsible for working within the Propulsion Systems Virtual Engineering team, focusing on simulations to support product development and research activity in the areas of dynamics for durability, functionality, and NVH. It includes ownership of collecting input data, developing and validating 1D, 2D, and 3D virtual models, running simulations, post-processing, and communicating analytical results to customers. The position also involves responding to requests from product-responsible departments by delivering analytical results using available methodologies, as well as proposing and developing new virtual tools and methods whenever existing solutions are not sufficient to meet project demands. The position defines and executes the development and validation of Multi-Body Dynamics (MBD) and Finite Element (FE) models for propulsion components, sub systems, and complete systems. This scope encompasses the dynamic behavior of internal combustion engine mechanical systems—including timing drives, valvetrains, FEAD, direct injection pumps, and balancer shafts—as well as the dynamic behavior and NVH phenomena, such as rattle and whine, of transmissions and hybrid torsional dampers. Additionally, the role manages critical driveline phenomena including powerhop, ice rink, and tip-in/tip-out clunk, alongside park gear systems and wheel end disconnect mechanisms.
